visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In the first phase, a woman wearing a light blue denim jacket stands in front of a traditional Japanese shrine. She holds a small fishing-style rod over a bin filled with pink heart-shaped charms. Her face is obscured by a large white heart emoji. (2) The scene transitions into a montage of lifestyle shots: a night view of Tokyo's city lights from an observatory, a laptop screen showing Japanese text on a desk, and a stylized indoor garden display with characters resembling Disney's Ariel and Eric. (3) An exterior shot shows the bright yellow 'Don Quijote' (Shibuya Donki) building, followed by an interior scene where a young woman with short bangs and a light blue dress waves and smiles at the camera. (4) A rapid sequence showcases several household products: 'nepia' panda-themed tissues, colorful ByUR facial mask packets, and liquid being squeezed from a mask onto a hand. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail setting. (5) The woman demonstrates a cooling wipe on her neck while sitting in a car, then presents a box of Morinaga Chocochips and a small red and white box containing a Tomica toy police car. (6) A young toddler in a blue and white striped shirt is seen playing with a yellow toy car on a bed next to an open picture book. The lighting is warm and domestic. (7) The footage returns to the store, showing rows of green tea products and household cleaners. The woman is seen carrying a black shopping basket filled with items. (8) The final phase shows the two women sitting together on a train, a view of a modest bedroom with a desk and luggage, and a hand holding a Taiwan passport and a boarding pass at an airport terminal.
